what: AR46, Hard's ember on the Shade (the Brawler, Red): the masks' cuts in the ember with the paper's glow off, and the coat's cracks lit from within. Research's pick B without C (2026-11-19, 17:42), the cracks' second look passed at competent (17:56). From tools/blender/hard_cut.py, baked from hard_ember.py's stand-in

maps.note: All of the foe's pieces share one atlas: on Hard, the five body pieces, the four masks and the elite's second mask wear the Hard glow map and one Hard colour map; the roughness stays the foe's own. Shade_Color_HardRed.png is the Red type's, checked against the stand-in; the other 4 types' are one run of hard_cut.py's `colours` mode, on the atlas route's pick. A mask's texels are the same in every type's map

body.note: the type's colour is in the colour map under the body's glow; at Config.Shades' body strength (16) every lit pixel draws as on Normal and the cracks draw their own amber

masks.note: as today: the maps carry the cuts' ember and the paper's dark

burst.on: every picture whose Kind is not scrap (charge, flare, flame)
burst.scraps: ImageColor3 white, on every difficulty (the content check's condition)

fit.note: the cut's frame against the stand-in B's, in 8-bit steps, where a foe stands: a crack's edge is a touch softer in the atlas's texels, and the trim's daylit part a touch redder

ways.the atlas, a colour map per type: no new parts or meshes. Per foe, 5 Hard colour maps (one per type, Config.Shades.Tint) and one Hard glow map: 12 images for the two foes. A Hard foe wears its type's pair: a Hard template per foe and type, or a Hard SurfaceAppearance per type cloned onto the pieces at spawn. Each new type adds a colour map per foe
ways.the atlas, with TintMask: no new parts or meshes, and type-free: per foe, the TintMask colour map and the Hard glow map, 4 images for the two foes. On Hard, AlphaMode TintMask, SurfaceAppearance.Color the type's colour, EmissiveTint white. Unchecked: TintMask is still a beta (Roblox's announcement), and nothing read says whether its tint reaches the glow; a few minutes in Studio show it. If it doesn't, the trim glows white
ways.a shell: the body's maps and tint stay as they are. Each body piece gets a second, slightly larger MeshPart carrying only the cracks, with a transparent colour map and a glow map, type-free: per foe 5 more meshes to upload and 2 images, and the masks still wear the Hard pair (2 images, type-free): 10 meshes and 8 images for the two foes, then 5 more MeshParts and welds on each Hard foe at spawn, and a transparent layer that can sort or fight with the body. Not made: on Faber's pick

conditions: each crack keeps its ramp, amber at its core falling to coral, never flat or dark red
every crack is anchored at a hem, a cuff or a foot, or tapers at both ends; none ends in a bead
no short isolated marks; nothing on the mask, the face, the hands or the trim; gone by the chest
the burst's paper stays cream on every difficulty
the built Hard foes get their own content check before upload
